issues.summary: Health certificate for frozen shrimp (HBL MFCIM260006 / MBL PSSU260222, container PSSU1961220 40RF) was missing, preventing the broker from filing the import declaration until Blue Harbor Foods sent it on 2026-02-23.
Customs clearance for container PSSU1961220 was urgent because free time expired on 2026-02-25, so the declaration was filed via priority slot and release obtained on 2026-02-24.

decisions.summary: Written notice sent to consignee before free-time expiry stating any charges after 2026-02-25 for container PSSU1961220 would be for the consignee's account.
Decided to file the import declaration for HBL MFCIM260006 on 2026-02-23 using the priority slot to clear within free time ending 2026-02-25.

deadlines.what: Free time expiry for container PSSU1961220 (40RF) with Pacific Star Shipping.
